construction_findings.finding: the first migration-ledger insertion attempted psql client-variable substitution in a command string where substitution was not performed
construction_findings.correction: validate the migration identity and digest before embedding those controlled values in the ledger statement

construction_findings.finding: the migration runner was not executable through its documented direct invocation path
construction_findings.correction: set the runner mode to 0755 and replay the direct invocation

construction_findings.finding: an operator check supplied generic DATABASE_URL instead of the required test-only variable
construction_findings.correction: retain the narrow RECOVERIES_TEST_DATABASE_URL boundary and correct the invocation

construction_findings.finding: a ledger inspection query requested a nonexistent digest column
construction_findings.correction: inspect the canonical table definition and query the sha256 column

construction_findings.finding: the staged-diff gate rejected trailing blank lines in seven Step 6 files before commit
construction_findings.correction: remove the blank lines, invalidate the pre-correction migration hashes, and replay a fresh disposable database before commit
